{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Grey suit jacket, single-breasted, hip length, tailored fit, heather grey (#8C8F94), textured wool blend

Grey suit trousers, straight leg, full ankle-grazing length, matching heather grey (#8C8F94), textured wool blend

Blouse, classic cut with a soft collar, tucked in, hip-skimming, ivory (#F2EDE4), crepe

Loafers, almond toe, low block heel, burgundy (#6D2A35), smooth leather

Belt, slim, burgundy (#6D2A35), smooth leather

Earrings, small hoops, polished silver (#C0C0C0), sterling silver

Tote bag, structured, medium size, charcoal (#3B3D42), grained leather

This outfit works because the matching grey jacket and trousers give you the suit you asked for, and the wool texture keeps it polished and right for a neat office day. The ivory blouse softens the grey and brightens the face, while the burgundy loafers and belt add a warm autumn touch without breaking the business look. Your silver earrings pick up the cool tone of the suit and finish it quietly. The jacket serves as the layer for autumn, so the look stays comfortable from the commute to the desk."}
